critical_code_review_comments: CreateInquiryDialog.submit() fix is correct and localized — filters out empty-string / null / undefined values before POST. force flag is still appended after the filter, so duplicate-force path is preserved.
Consider also applying the same empty-string strip in future forms that hit EmailStr/date validators (Applications, Users) to avoid recurrence.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (platform dashboard render, create inquiry happy-path, duplicate detection + force-create)

context_for_next_testing_agent: CreateInquiryDialog fix verified. Tenant crm-27224 now has INQ-2026-000001..000003 seeded via UI runs. Backend suite (72 tests) remains the source-of-truth regression harness — run with `pytest backend/tests/ -v --tb=short`. For platform login the login form auto-routes to /platform for role=platform_admin without needing tenant slug; for school login the tenant field auto-fills once the email is typed (or is unnecessary because email is scoped by tenant subdomain-less flow in this env).
rca of the issue: Previous 422 was caused by parent_email='' being sent to Pydantic EmailStr. Fix in CreateInquiryDialog.submit() constructs payload via Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(form).filter(([,v]) => v !== '' && v !== null && v !== undefined)) prior to POST, so empty optional fields are omitted. Verified end-to-end: happy-path create succeeds (INQ-2026-000002) and duplicate-force create succeeds (INQ-2026-000003).
